item.content:encoded:
And just so you know, by "the federal government, the United Nations, and Jerusalem", he's alluding to the UIU, GOC, and Horizon Initiative.

Oh. That's significantly less threatening than I interpreted it.

So that line basically means "If you don't accept, I'll go ask the UIU/GOC/HI for help instead" instead of "If you don't accept, I'll have to lord over the major national, international, and religious institutions to further my ends like I'm demonstrating power over you right now". That makes significantly more sense.

Do not fear.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Two pieces, connected as part of a larger storyline.

Thanks to all the people who helped with Sanctuary, and to Decibelle, TwistedGears, Randomini, Vince, and everyone else who pitched in help with the writing and design for The Beginning of the End.

For a hint if you're stuck in The Beginning Of The End:

Spoiler
Necessary to see the real story

You need to get the bureaucrat rank "The Pawn" to see the real ending. All other ranks lead to a "failure state", essentially, including both approving everything and denying everything.

A list of what is reimagined:

Spoiler
– hide block

Primary characters:
SCP-343
SCP-732

Secondary is MTF Omega-7, including
SCP-076
SCP-105
SCP-079

Several other SCPs are mentioned, but their roles are too minor to count as a proper reimagining.

An explanation of some of the notation in 343's pidgin logic-English:

Spoiler?
– hide block

"~" is "the negation of" or "not"
":=" means "is defined as"
":" and "::" form analogies: "X is to Y as A is to B"
"v" means "or"
"P" is the proposition at hand
"→" means "if, then"
"↔" means "if and only if, then"
"∃" means "there exists"; "∃!" means "there exists exactly one"
"⊕" means "mutually exclusive"
"⊤" means "is necessarily true"

EDIT: In the interest of giving credit where credit's due, the CSS theme I used here is a derivative of the "Hypercane" style featured here.
